id: title:aspicer:compare boolean properties to text as text on native events

review.posthog_relevance: Changes HogQL query planning and property comparison behavior for Boolean and Numeric types against text literals, potentially affecting result correctness and performance for users querying these property types.
review.reason: The chunk contains a cohesive documentation update and corresponding implementation changes. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 demonstrate a substantive, bounded change to HogQL's query planning and property resolution, specifically allowing Boolean properties to be compared as text when conversion fails and removing the previous Numeric-only optimization. P1.F1.H1 provides documentation align
review.uncertainty: While the implementation and documentation are present, the actual runtime impact on query results and performance is not demonstrated by execution or test results in this chunk. The benefit is inferred from the code change rather than observed. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 maintenance-only status is supported. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive group of changes. No unrelated PRs are present. No score is assigned; tier assignment requires a score, not an observation. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: the hogql-python handbook no longer claims Numeric, Boolean and DateTime keep conversions when compared with strings; it now states Numeric and Boolean compare as text when a string literal cannot be converted, and Boolean literals keep ClickHouse's case-insensitive spellings.
observations.code_quote: Numeric and Boolean properties on the native table compare as text when a string literal cannot be converted to the property's definition type.
observations.posthog_connection: This documentation aligns with the implementation change in P1.F2, which changes HogQL's behavior for Boolean and Numeric properties compared to text. It helps maintainers and users understand the new behavior.

observations.behavior: Code change: the HogQL property resolution implementation is extended to handle Boolean properties alongside Numeric properties when comparing to text. A new helper _typed_property_to_compare_as_text is added, and the existing _numeric_property_to_compare_as_text is removed. The check now also allows Boolean family types.
observations.posthog_connection: This is the implementation of the documented behavior. It allows Boolean properties to be compared as text when the literal cannot be read as a Boolean, while still preserving the original property type for other cases. This could affect query optimization and result correctness for Boolean properties compared to text literals.

observations.behavior: Code change: the optimization path for native JSON string comparisons no longer short-circuits Boolean conversions. Instead, it checks whether the expression is a swapper Boolean conversion; if not, it proceeds to try materialized string or typed text comparisons.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk changes the HogQL query planner's behavior for native JSON string comparisons. It could affect how queries are optimized and executed, potentially changing performance or results for Boolean properties compared to text.
